title: 更新计划先分类冲突，再自动应用无歧义增量
summary: 远程/外部更新不应把“新增、已有、已有但变化、变量、冲突”压成一个下载列表。先形成可审计计划；有冲突或已有对象变化时保留双方证据并转人工审查，自动动作只处理可靠识别的增量。
invariants: Conflicting upstream rows sharing one display basename are not resolved by last-row-wins.
Source-text changes and comparable audio SHA-256 changes are reported separately from new logical rows.
Ambiguous identity remains explicit with candidate records attached for review.
Existing rows remain read-only to automatic download/adoption unless a separate replacement workflow exists.
Repeated update planning excludes already applied/indexed additions without erasing historical evidence.
